MECHANISM: Tenth cross-head relative-bias tie

HYPOTHESIS: Sharing the next head-specific relative-attention bias will reduce the verified model from 606 to 605 learned parameters while retaining at least 99% accuracy, because the adjacent nine biases already share successfully and this reparameterization preserves the initialized function exactly.

INTENDED_EDIT: Shorten the head-specific relative-bias table by one column and reconstruct that column from a new zero-initialized scalar shared across both heads.

EVIDENCE: The 606-parameter model achieved 99.89% accuracy with nine adjacent cross-head bias ties; earlier attempts at the tenth tie were unverifiable and therefore provide no contrary accuracy result.
